newsitem.title: UK: IBCA says monitoring Mexico, sees progress.
newsitem.headline: IBCA says monitoring Mexico, sees progress.

text.p: European rating agency IBCA said on Monday it was continuing to monitor the situation in Mexico, which it viewed as showing "progress".

Preliminary results from Mexico's elections showed the ruling Institutional Revolutionary Party (PRI) losing control of the lower house of Congress for the first time since the party was founded in 1929.

"We are reviewing the situation on an ongoing basis," said Richard Fox, senior economist at IBCA sovereign ratings. "The political side is one area we are looking for progress, and we feel there has been progress."
